items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: this was the time right around this time, was when Benny Goodman started in the Congress Hotel down there.

ctx.x: Right, everything was -- they hadn't -- right at that time, they hadn't really categorized anything because this was the time right around this time, was when Benny Goodman started in the Congress Hotel down there. And then they started calling it Swing, right.

So that's where -- we started from there. But this night club, we played all kind -- we had a little line of girls, four girls or five girls. Little productions. But I had -- just like I said, I was straight, because I knew what I was doing then.
